summary: Munzingen-born master mason who settled in Basel; possibly a brother or half-brother of Servatius Birkenmaier.
bio: Johann Birkenmeier was born at Munzingen, near Freiburg in Baden, in 1808, the illegitimate son of Walburga Birkenberger. He became a master mason in Basel. With Carolina Belinger, as her name appears to read, he had a daughter, Agatha Carolina, born on 28 January 1838, who died in Basel on 1 April 1844; her death was certified there and copied into the Munzingen death register. He may have been a brother or half-brother of Servatius Birkenmaier, but that is only a guess.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, Standesbücher 1840–1870; 631 images; record id 5-480947), deaths 1844 No. 11 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-125

Round 4: brief pass. A Johann Birkenmaier, single mason, witnessed Karolina Birkenmaier's death in Munzingen in 1869. That man is a younger namesake, not this Basel mason born 1808, but it shows the Birkenmaier mason clan was still active in Munzingen.
